title: The Threshold Gate
description: A vibrant fantasy landscape at twilight featuring an ornate open metal gate covered in glowing yellow flowers and dripping golden sap in the foreground. A winding turquoise river flows under a stone bridge toward a distant castle perched on a cliff, surrounded by towering spiral flower structures under a starry purple sky with multiple crescent moons and a dragon flying near a large moon.
prompt: Fantasy twilight landscape with an ornate metal gate covered in glowing yellow blossoms and dripping golden sap in the foreground, labeled 'The Threshold'. A turquoise river winds through green hills under a stone bridge toward a fairy tale castle on a distant cliff. Tall spiraling towers of flowers with dripping sap rise into the sky. A dragon flies near a large crescent moon in a purple starry sky filled with multiple smaller moons.
